subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

Option 1) TZ—YC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30817160abc4ed090736c0d7e0cdbd6bd2c9957d4078fa72ad66169ad720d058.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0269a7d0dea8f3c0c840e54eda39881ff02716db498887d393dc95593c8cb4f4.png] 

Option 2) BH-GK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a239186168f36d4e9935943bcfd32d5f73eafb56b99a6bca778b6e1a461637d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c4edb5e6d2417c41f205d52be6b9aa1ff67652c6503d0b3baae8859559626b0.png] 

Option 3) WC -BF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22866e74df93b093c36ac94e6ac9709563a3a18bcdb00f4585aac3b55f7da2d9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5624564f3af928452587322ed3af7be1eee56a94eac02250adf5f791764088b.png] 

Option 4) AD-YW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c122af7966c7416b203d71e31952f3c512ebfdc19cb50330f5648adfc3c4c114.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50afe2158c04addf8c70b06fd5307d3a8b073d002a2a68b1859b0da52064e1d7.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'AD-YW' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
